description: Create a shop. The caller becomes its one owner. The caller must already have accepted the current Terms and Privacy, once for their account, which covers every shop. Until then this call is refused and names /p/legal. On the sign-up page, one checkbox records both current versions (accept_terms_version) with the version, time, IP address and browser. A person who already accepted is not asked again. An agent cannot agree for them. owner_name, when it is a real name, replaces a display name that is only the email local part.

accept_terms_version.description: Sign-up page only: the person agreed to the current Terms and Privacy Policy

owner_name.description: The person's name, when they typed one. Replaces a display name that is only the email local part.

name: shops_create
